book.name: EPESO
book.title: ME EPESO ꞌIDI LETA PAULO ꞌIꞌETOLADINA

content: Paulo ꞌina guinuwa taudi nigeya me Yudia soladiya

Gete manuna ꞌaboꞌagu Paulo yabwagobwago ta yasidasida Yaubada ꞌenaya, tauna ꞌigu paisewa ꞌiꞌebwaꞌeguya ꞌomi nigeya me Yudia ꞌemiya, ta gete tuga Keliso ꞌina guinuwa manuna deliya sisaꞌu luguyegu ga yamiyami.
Nai lowa ꞌigu guinuwa tetelina wanonona, ta ꞌigu guinuwa nina Yaubada ꞌiꞌebwaꞌegu, be ꞌaene tauna ꞌina oboboma ꞌenega ꞌomi ꞌami lema wada loba.
Ta ꞌigu guinuwa gete sinasinapu lowa kwaikwaiyina, Yaubada tauna ꞌana mwalatoi niꞌatu ꞌieꞌitegu, nadigega yaꞌetoladinawa ꞌimi leta kukupana ꞌena,
be ꞌeguma wasawai wada mwalamwalatoni ꞌaene sinasinapu kwaikwaiyina nina Keliso manuna niꞌatu yamwalatonina.
Ta sinasinapu nina ꞌepatao taudi sigumwalaya nigeya simwalamwalatoni, ga gete tuga Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌigieapwesena ꞌina tosimanao esiesinuwadi be palopitao ꞌediya,

ꞌaene ꞌomi nigeya me Yudia sawesawenaya be Yaubada ꞌina ꞌetoseyana walobai, ꞌaboꞌama me Yudia nadigega, ta ꞌina ꞌetoseyana nina lowa ꞌiona upaupaenaya, ga Yesu Keliso tetelina ꞌenega talobena, ga taeboda ꞌebweu.
Ta Yaubada ꞌina waiwaiyega be ꞌina obobomega paisewa gete ꞌiꞌebwaꞌegu, be ꞌaene tetela boboꞌana Keliso manuna yada simasimana apwese.

Ta ꞌaboꞌagu ꞌatuwa gomabeso toekalesiyao soladiya, ta tuwa tuga ꞌina obobomega paisewa gete ꞌiꞌebwaꞌegu, be ꞌomi nigeya me Yudia ꞌemiya Keliso tetelina yada loguguyae, be ꞌenega ꞌina esaesa sinabwa wawasae wada ꞌitalobadi,
be wate tomota maiboꞌadi sida mwalatoni ꞌaene Yaubada tauna yage maiboꞌadi ꞌadi tomweluluwa, ta tuta dudulana ꞌediya ꞌina nuwanuwa ꞌikwaiyena, ga niꞌatu ꞌigieapwesena,
ꞌaene ꞌebeꞌita ꞌaboꞌada toekalesiyao, be ꞌedega Yaubada ꞌina mwalatoi maiboꞌana ꞌieꞌitae galewa ꞌana yaluyaluwa waiwaidi ꞌediya.
Gete Yaubada ꞌina nuwanuwa lowaenei ga batuwa, ta gete tuga ꞌigieapwesena ꞌida ꞌInapwana Yesu Keliso ꞌenega,
be ꞌabo Keliso nina taemise taꞌatepatu, be sawesawenaya talulugu Yaubada tauna matanaya, be tasidasida ꞌenaya.
ꞌEnega ꞌigu ꞌelouya manumi bada geyaꞌabo manuna ꞌatemi sineeneta, ta esi wada mwalatoni ꞌaene ꞌigu ꞌelouyao getedi ꞌomi ꞌami ꞌetoseyana manuna.
Keliso ꞌina oboboma sinabwana
ꞌEnega ꞌaboꞌagu yaꞌaetulasa Tamada matanaya,
tauna susu maiboꞌadi galewaya ta baleꞌuya ꞌaledi,
ta yasidasida ꞌenaya be ꞌaene ꞌina esaesa be ꞌina waiwai ꞌediyega ꞌitatagwala ꞌemiya, be Yaluyaluwana ꞌatemi ꞌida giewaiwaiyedi,
be wate ꞌimi emisega Keliso ꞌida miyami ꞌatemiya, be adelimi maiboꞌana oboboma tuga,

ꞌenega toekalesiyao maiboꞌadi maꞌemiyao sawesawemiya Keliso ꞌina oboboma wada mwalatoi ꞌaiꞌaili, ꞌana bababa, ꞌana dudula, ꞌana tuꞌe, ꞌana mwaꞌuta, nigeya ꞌana ꞌetopwapwamo. Keliso ꞌina oboboma sinabwa wawasae, be wate Yaubada Toewaiwai sana ꞌina bubunega ꞌida loemaa ꞌaiꞌailimi.
Onaꞌaiꞌaila, ꞌina waiwai soladaya ꞌietaetapewa, be ꞌeguma toꞌase manuna tasidasida ma ida emisa, tauna sawesawenaya be ꞌida guinuwe, ma ꞌana loeposeyana sinabwana manuda.
ꞌEnega toekalesiyao maiboꞌada Yesu Keliso ꞌana esanega tada tupu atae, ꞌepata be ꞌepata ꞌediya. Eimeni.
